senses.gloss:
Pharvara, a word occurring only once in the Rigveda,^1
cannot be interpreted with certainty. It may mean a ‘field in
bloom.’^2 Sāyaṇa^3 explains it as ‘filler,’ and Grassmann as
perhaps a ‘sower.’^4
1) x. 106, 2.
2) Cf. Weber, Indische Studien, 17, 260.
3) In his commentary on Rv. x. 106, 2.
He explains the intensive form par-
pharat, occurring in the same hymn
(x. 106, 7), as from a verb meaning
to ‘fill.’
4) Wörterbuch, s.v.
